name: Hotel Garni Elfriede
beschreibung: The Hotel Garni Elfriede is situated in a quiet location in the Tiroler Bergwelt. It offers a family atmosphere and comfortably furnished rooms. The surrounding area is characterized by mountains and nature and invites guests to enjoy activities. In summer, hiking trails are available; in winter, ski areas. The amenities include a breakfast room, a wellness area with sauna, and parking. Guests can expect accommodation with breakfast and a quiet location.
